rules.statement: The District Committee has no power to appoint a priest as a provisional trustee under section 34 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Per DALTON J.-The District Committee has no power to appoint a priest as a provisional trustee under section 34 of the Ordinance."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 34 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, 1905
